say:1:1037022001:1.text: Those were not mistakes! They were sins!
say:1:1037022001:1.source_cn: 他犯下的不是过错，而是罪孽！

say:2:1037022002:1.text: Misarte's people have been displaced because of him, and the land has lost its vitality. These things are not easily remedied.
say:2:1037022002:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒的子民因为他流离失所，土地也丧失了活力，短期内难...

say:3:1037022003:1.text: Such heavy consequences for his actions... no, even the Deer Spirit will never forgive him!
say:3:1037022003:1.source_cn: 如此深重的恶果……即使是宽容的鹿灵也不会原谅他！
